//: Userscript bundle: src/*.js are CONCATENATION FRAGMENTS, not modules (the top-level IIFE is opened in src/main.js and closed in src/ui.js — see build.order.json + scripts/build.js). They share globals across the bundle (DEFAULT_SETTINGS, PAGE_WINDOW, GM_*, unsafeWindow), so any per-file TS/JS checker produces hundreds of false positives and parse errors. Real quality gates live in `npm run validate`: ESLint + Jest (44 tests) + check-modules + check-version + check-locales + build + validate-build. This tsconfig exists only to give the editor reasonable defaults for scripts/ and test/; src/ is intentionally excluded.
